title: Dates, months and birthdays (Das Datum)
summary: Say the date, your birthday, and the month or season something happens. Learn the ordinal numbers: der erste, der dritte.
goals: Name the months and the seasons
Say the date: Heute ist der dritte Oktober
Say when: am dritten Oktober, im Oktober, im Sommer
Ask about birthdays, say yours, and congratulate someone

nicosWeg.title: Nicos Weg A1, chapter 8: Appointments (Hast du morgen Zeit?)

sections.text:
All months are [[der]], like the days, and most look like English. Watch the spelling of [[März]] (with ä) and the sound of [[Juni]] and [[Juli]]: they are easy to mix up when you listen, so people often say [[Juno]] and [[Julei]] on the phone to keep them apart.

[[der Monat]] = the month, [[das Jahr]] = the year: [[Das Jahr hat zwölf Monate.]]

sections.title: am and im are chunks for now
sections.text: [[am]] is short for 'an dem' and [[im]] for 'in dem'. Why German needs [[dem]] here comes in Unit 6. For now, learn the table above as it is: [[um]] for the clock, [[am]] for days and dates, [[im]] for months and seasons.

sections.title: First, second, third: ordinal numbers
sections.text:
For dates German uses ordinal numbers (first, second, third ...). The rule:
- up to 19: number + **-te**: [[vier]], [[vierte]]; [[zehn]], [[zehnte]]; [[neunzehn]], [[neunzehnte]]
- from 20: number + **-ste**: [[zwanzig]], [[zwanzigste]]; [[einunddreißig]], [[einunddreißigste]]

Only three are irregular: [[erste]] (1st), [[dritte]] (3rd), [[siebte]] (7th). And [[achte]] (8th) has just one t.

In writing, a dot after the number makes it ordinal: '3.' means [[dritte]].

sections.title: Saying the date
sections.text:
- To ask: [[Welches Datum ist heute?]] (or [[Der Wievielte ist heute?]])
- The date: [[Heute ist der dritte Oktober.]] After [[der]], the ending is **-te**.
- On a date: [[am dritten Oktober]]. After [[am]], the ending is **-ten**.

So: **der ...te, am ...ten**: [[der erste Mai]], [[am ersten Mai]]. Unit 6 explains the -n; for now it's a chunk.

Dates are written day first: 3.10. or 3. Oktober. In speech most people say the month's name: [[der dritte Oktober]]. You may also hear the month as a number: [[der dritte Zehnte]] (the tenth month).

Russian also uses ordinal numbers for dates: третье октября is [[der dritte Oktober]], and третьего октября is [[am dritten Oktober]]. Armenian uses the plain number instead (հոկտեմբերի երեքը), so don't copy that: it's never 'am drei Oktober'.

sections.title: Birthdays
sections.text:
- [[Wann hast du Geburtstag?]] = When is your birthday? (Literally: when do you have birthday?)
- [[Ich habe am zwölften März Geburtstag.]] or [[Mein Geburtstag ist am zwölften März.]]
- [[Ich bin am zwölften März geboren.]] = I was born on the twelfth of March. It looks like 'I am born'; learn it as a chunk.
- [[Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!]] = Happy birthday!

Years up to 1999 are said in hundreds: 1999 = [[neunzehnhundertneunundneunzig]]. From 2000 they are said in thousands: 2026 = [[zweitausendsechsundzwanzig]].

sections.title: Not before the day
sections.text: Many Germans think it brings bad luck to say [[Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!]] before the actual day. Wait until the day itself, or say it a day late.

sections.title: Two dates in Munich
sections.text: [[Der dritte Oktober ist ein Feiertag.]] It's German Unity Day, and the shops are closed. And the Oktoberfest takes place mostly in September: [[Das Oktoberfest fängt im September an.]]

items.de: Welches Datum ist heute? - Heute ist der zwölfte Mai.
items.en: What's the date today? - Today is the twelfth of May.

items.de: Wann hast du Geburtstag? - Am dritten März.
items.en: When is your birthday? - On the third of March.

items.de: Im Winter ist es früh dunkel.
items.en: In winter it gets dark early.

items.de: Der Kurs fängt am ersten Februar an.
items.en: The class starts on the first of February.

items.de: der erste, der zweite, der dritte
items.en: the first, the second, the third

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: Today is the third of October.
items.explanation: 3rd is irregular: dritte. After der: der dritte Oktober.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: on the first of May
items.explanation: After am the ending is -ten: am ersten Mai.

items.question: Which one means 'in October'?
items.explanation: Months and seasons take im: im Oktober, im Sommer.

items.audio: Mein Geburtstag ist am siebten Juli.
items.question: When is the birthday?
items.explanation: am siebten Juli = on the 7th of July. siebte (7th) is irregular; siebzehnte would be the 17th.
Alles Gute zum Geburtstag! Literally: all the best for the birthday.
